children: Kinetiq has a KNTQ supply unlock scheduled for October 2027. At least 12.92 million KNTQ will unlock for investors and team members. That amount equals 3.57% of the circulating supply.

The unlock lets investors and team members sell tokens that were previously locked. If they sell some of those tokens, the sales would add to the amount of KNTQ offered on the market and could put pressure on its price.

title: Kinetiq: Supply unlock releases at least 12.92 million KNTQ - Oct 2027
